Question B-001-014-002.

Why the correct answer is right: For foreign operators other than United States citizens, Canada requires a country agreement and the appropriate permit.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Amateur radio operators are automatically granted equivalent privileges in all member states of the International Telecommunication Union": International Telecommunication Union membership alone does not automatically grant equivalent amateur privileges in Canada.
- sourceIndex 2: "Canada automatically grants privileges to visiting amateur radio operators": Canada does not automatically grant visitor privileges without the agreement-and-permit condition.
- sourceIndex 3: "The foreign amateur radio operator must submit an application to Radio Amateurs of Canada (RAC)": RAC is not the permit condition named for this visitor authority.
